9d351a80-5037-4334-a020-6985899f5b1f.title: Maou ni Natta node, Dungeon Tsukutte Jingai Musume to Honobono Suru
9d351a80-5037-4334-a020-6985899f5b1f.altTitle: Now I'm a Demon Lord! Happily Ever After with Monster Girls in My Dungeon
9d351a80-5037-4334-a020-6985899f5b1f.description:
Before I realized, I had become the guardian of a dungeon, a Demon Lord. I was suddenly in a dangerous world with giant monsters loitering around, fighting for their existence. So I thought to go about developing the dungeon in order to not die, but for some reason I was having quite the good time... How did it turn out like this?  
  
The protagonist, Yuki, having to live in that world now, uses his bold and sharp senses and spends time with a supreme dragon girl and a vampire girl, sometimes laughing, sometimes being angry, passing days doing what he likes.

b49fd121-19bf-4344-a8e1-d1be7ca04e08.title: Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha, Isekai Kizoku ni Tensei Suru
b49fd121-19bf-4344-a8e1-d1be7ca04e08.altTitle: The World's Best Assassin, Reincarnated in a Different World as an Aristocrat
b49fd121-19bf-4344-a8e1-d1be7ca04e08.description:
The most dangerous prey... When the most accomplished assassin on Earth meets his end just before retirement, he finds himself standing before a goddess. Her world is headed for disaster, and she has need of his particular set of skills. Armed with powerful new abilities and decades of deadly knowledge, he begins his second life as Lugh, young scion of the Tuatha Dé clan of assassins. His mission: to find and eliminate the strongest individual in this world-the hero!

*Source: Yen Press, Vol. 1*

643297aa-670a-4a84-9653-3586da00721c.title: I'm Quitting the Hero's Party
643297aa-670a-4a84-9653-3586da00721c.altTitle: I Quit the Party of the Brave.
643297aa-670a-4a84-9653-3586da00721c.description:
Raniel Van Trias, the Ashen Wizard, is a highly skilled mage set on defeating the Demon King. After years of fighting alongside the renowned Hero's Party and multiple encounters with the Demon King, he is ousted from the party, left with a curse on his heart, forced to lose half his lifespan, and transformed into a woman! 

Undeterred, Raniel becomes an assistant professor at the Royal Apelia Academy as Rania and searches for a way to lift the curse, oblivious to how challenging his task may be...

a2967217-2c07-4216-b05a-ac3302a4dd66.title: 8Seokeul Mabeobsaui Hwansaeng
a2967217-2c07-4216-b05a-ac3302a4dd66.description:
Henry Morris was an 8-circled wizard who was a legend- one of the founding fathers who helped his friend become the king of a unified empire. After the son took over the throne, Henry was executed with the false accusation of leading a rebellion against the empire. 

He then wakes up in the body of young Henry Morris, the eldest of a baron family, who also happened to have the same name. 

Henry turns his life around by again relearning magic and also swordsmanship in order to become the first magic swordsman, all for the sake of revenge.

d2b02bb0-a8ec-405f-9c2d-d63df7cff785.description: Middle school life isn’t all fun and games for an art club girl either! From club activities to studying, games to manga, hobbies, BL, and “mufufu” fantasies… or even…love?! “Uchida” is a member of the Art Club. She’s got a lot of strange obsessions and she’s not great at dealing with people. A short candid manga about the ups and downs of school life with the classmates surrounding her and the adolescent boy who sits next to her.

274827f3-99da-4f73-b324-b740a828d422.title: Hoegwi Geomga ui Seoja ga Saneun Beop
274827f3-99da-4f73-b324-b740a828d422.altTitle: Regressing as the Bastard of the Sword Clan
274827f3-99da-4f73-b324-b740a828d422.description:
Theo Ragnar, the 31st son of the mighty Grand Duke of Ragnar, was born without the legendary Ragnar Gift — a fatal flaw in a family where might is right. Labeled the Ragnar Defect, he and his mother were betrayed, meeting a brutal end at the hands of those they trusted. 

But death was only the beginning. 

Reborn at 17, Theo awakens not only with the Ragnar Gift, but with powers far beyond imagination. Fueled by vengeance and a second chance, he sets out to claim the glory he was once denied.

1c258c7a-5529-4fde-b6c0-f8028223993b.description:

5ff9e370-a993-4f3b-9e70-750c3a098fc5.title: Janbul ui Gisa
5ff9e370-a993-4f3b-9e70-750c3a098fc5.description:
When Nagyunn’s twin brother, Najin, is murdered before his very eyes, he vows to avenge his brother’s death by assuming Najin’s identity. 

But although the two may look alike, when it comes to fighting, Nagyunn lacks the talent and skill his brother possessed. In order to successfully execute his plot for revenge, Nagyunn resolves to train himself to become the prodigious knight-in-training his brother once was. 

Will Nagyunn be able to keep his identity a secret before others begin to catch on to his act?

dc53a9b8-98c2-4268-a3b8-dd1aed596d9f.title: Half Blood
dc53a9b8-98c2-4268-a3b8-dd1aed596d9f.description:
Half-blooded Leon was born between a human and an ogre. But all that returns to him as a half-blood is exploitation and betrayal by humans. 

Leon despises such humans and vows revenge. 

To Leon, who always suffered because he lacked power, fortune comes calling, and he’s given an opportunity to take revenge on humans.
